latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of markdown-converter skill.

- Converts documents (PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel) to Markdown via markitdown.
- Supports 50+ generative AI models for image, video, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, music, chat, web search, document parsing, email, and SMS across multiple providers.
- Unified API for model access, auto-selection of optimal provider, and flexible model/task filtering.
- Includes detailed usage examples for each model type with code snippets.
- Requires a single API key (`SKILLBOSS_API_KEY`) for authentication.
